mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, parent_id, org_code, org_name, org_type, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: select from sys_org where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0 order by parent_id asc, sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.update: update sys_org set parent_id = #{parentId}, org_name = #{orgName}, org_type = #{orgType}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
